scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare: the headline quantities are computed structures and dipole moment; comparing the agent's reported values to the experimental reference with method‑specific tolerances is the appropriate check because recomputing the full quantum‑chemical optimizations inside the verifier sandbox is infeasible.

hidden_assets.purpose: Experimental heavy‑atom structural parameters and dipole moment of bicyclo[1.1.1]pentanone (Table V exptl column).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table V (exptl column) and text (dipole moment 3.16 D). Bond lengths: C=O 1.201 Å, C1‑C2 1.524 Å, C1‑C4 1.573 Å, C1…C3 1.955 Å. Bond angles: C1C2C3 79.8°, C1C4C3 76.9°, C2MC4 119.9°. Dipole moment: 3.16 D.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the experimentally measured and published reference values against which the paper compares its computed results; they serve as the hidden gold for verifying the agent's computed structures and dipole moment.

schema.description: Computed structural parameters and dipole moment for the four theoretical methods.

outputs.description: The single scored artifact: heavy‑atom bond lengths (Å), bond angles (°), and dipole moment (D) from MM2, MNDO, RHF/STO-3G, and RHF/3-21G optimizations. The hidden checker compares each parameter to the experimental reference from the paper, awarding full credit when the deviation is within a method‑specific tolerance (absolute error ≤ tolerance) and partial credit degrading as the error increases.
